name: Customer Discovery Interview (Community)
description: Generate a non-leading interview script and notes template based on The Mom Test.

steps.name: Interview Setup
steps.description: Tell me what you're trying to learn.

questions.question: What's the main thing you want to learn?
options: Whether they would use a solution

questions.question: What problem area are you exploring?
What's the specific task you want them to walk you through?
What assumptions do you want to test?

steps.name: Generate Interview Script
steps.description: Write the script and notes template.

config.promptTemplate: You are a customer-research expert trained in The Mom Test. Generate a complete interview script for the following founder. Goal: {{interviewGoal}}. Target: {{targetCustomer}}. Problem: {{problemArea}}. Walk-through task: {{relevantTask}}. Assumptions to test: {{assumptions}}. Output sections: Goal, Audience, Opening, Past Behavior, Workarounds, Cost, Closing, Notes Template. Rules: never ask hypothetical or leading questions. Always anchor to past behavior. No selling.
config.systemPrompt: Apply The Mom Test rigorously. Past behavior beats opinion. Never sell.

steps.name: Recruiting Message
steps.description: Short outreach message to find interviewees.

config.promptTemplate: Write a friendly 4-sentence outreach message asking {{targetCustomer}} for a 20-minute call about {{problemArea}}. No pitch. Offer to share findings. Sign as 'the founder'.
